## D — Accuracy

Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; the three elements, judgment, emotional and medical claims and the age statistics resolve to the first selected page, and the younger and older driver claims to the second.

Confidence: high across the section; every statement is printed directly on its page. One source-form caution: on the first page the word crashes and several age numerals in the statistics paragraph are set in a separate text run that interleaves with the paragraph in the snapshot's text layer, so the statistics were reassembled from the full page text and read in sentence order.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the driver's role among the three elements of driving, emotional fitness to drive, medical factors, the relationship between driver age and crashes, and the problems of younger and older drivers rules on pages 24–25 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
